status: final candidate approved by independent correctness and performance audit; root handles shared integration

correctness.candidate2_existing_audit: Superseded by independent final runtime/capped-wrapper audit recorded below.

changes: Canonical identity decoding recognizes only exact 48/96-byte canonical identity encodings before subgroup decoder.
Checked pairing products validate both operands of every original term before omitting neutral terms and grouping equal G2 operands; cancelling grouped terms remain neutral.
Public MSM uses width-four Straus for 2/3 terms and signed radix buckets for >=4 terms. 33 stack slots, at most 32 active magnitude buckets; cap128 and original error precedence preserved.
Empty group sums/MSM emit fixed canonical identity after unchanged packed count/scalar length validation.
IC duplicate message detection uses bounded merge sorting for >=16 entries and exact byte equality.

Ethereum aggregates reuse only byte-identical successfully verified key/proof pairs and message hashes <=1024 bytes within the current call. Different proofs are checked; messages >1024 bytes hash directly, bounding comparison work independently of message length.
unchanged_contracts: No public signature or opcode changes.
Secret single-point scalar multiplication path unchanged.
IC distinct-message and Ethereum PoP enforcement retained.
No native state or pointers retained between calls.
